title: StockSmart Demand Planning Table — Intermittent Consumption and the Weekly Draw of a Converted Bin
content:
**StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program — weekly draw behind the customer-owned fill-to level of a bin whose consigned item is converted to customer-owned replenishment at a par review.**

An item consumed only now and then is sized on its peaks.

**Rule.** Where the converted item's consumption was billed in 4 or fewer of the last twelve billing months, its weekly draw is its largest single billing month of consumption on record times 12 divided by 52; where it was billed in 5 to 8 of those months, its weekly draw is the midpoint (half, 0.5 times, the sum) of its largest single billing month on record and its average month (its consumption of the last twelve months divided by 12), and that midpoint is then multiplied by 12 and divided by 52; an item billed in more months is not re-based under this table, and an item with no consumption on record has a weekly draw of zero.

**Records.** The program's monthly consumption billing lines for the item: one line per billing month in which the item was consumed. The last twelve billing months are the lines of age below twelve, a row's age in whole months being the number of calendar months from its date to today, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than the row's day of the month. The largest single billing month is taken from every line on record, inside or outside the twelve months.

| Months billed in the last twelve | Largest month on record (hypothetical) | Twelve-month consumption (hypothetical) | Weekly draw |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 60 | 100 | 60 times 12, divided by 52: 13.846154 |
| 4 | 26 | 70 | 26 times 12, divided by 52: 6.000000 |
| 6 | 40 | 120 | midpoint of 40 and 10 is 25; 25 times 12, divided by 52: 5.769231 |
| 8 | 30 | 156 | midpoint of 30 and 13 is 21.5; times 12, divided by 52: 4.961538 |
| 9 or more | any | any | not re-based under this table |
| none, and no consumption on record | none | 0 | zero |

The boundaries are inclusive: 4 months falls in the first row's rule and 8 months in the second.
